body:
Myk's call (2026-08-21): rewrite the tutorial from scratch. The current one (§16, §19) is out
of date, never fully worked right, and collapses multiple things into single steps. The
requirements, from chat, verbatim in spirit:
- A person steps through TOP-LEVEL LESSONS; within each lesson, each specific step plays out
  ONE AT A TIME — no more collapsed compound steps.
- The user can REVERT to a prior state at any point.
- An OPTIONAL QUIZ after each lesson lets the user verify their understanding.

This is design-stage: the deliverable is a working spec at .adlc/specs/48-tutorial-v3.md (next
free section number; §19 stays as history) with user stories first, then criteria each naming
verification — and then STOP for Myk's word before implementation code. Design-stage never
self-merges.

Directions to develop in the working spec (recommendations, to be argued there):
- Dogfood the substrate: the tutorial's own progress is deltas in the student's tab-local store.
  Then REVERT is not app state to build — it is the store read at an earlier moment (§26 as-of)
  or a checkpoint re-seed, and the tutorial becomes its own best demonstration: the lesson about
  history IS history.
- Lesson/step model as data: lessons and steps as entities with a lens, so the tutorial content
  itself is claims — editable, versionable, as-of-able.
- Quiz shape: optional, per-lesson, answers checked locally in the tab; wrong answers point back
  at the step that teaches the thing. Never a gate — a mirror.
- The T143 lesson is binding: every lesson earns a story rail that drives the real surface.
  Precision about the precedent: the CURRENT tutorial's anti-rot rail (test/site/arc.test.ts)
  is headless Node driving lessons.mjs functions — no browser. Real CDP-driven rails exist
  for the door/login surface (test/browser/cdp.ts is the frozen driver;
  human-doors.test.ts the pattern). Tutorial v3's story rails should use the CDP driver —
  that is the upgrade, not the status quo. A lesson with no executable form is a lesson not
  yet specified.
- UX debt to fix by design, not patch: one step, one action, one observable result; the reset/
  revert affordance visible at every step; a student who closes the tab resumes where they were.

Acceptance criteria for THIS ticket (the design phase):
(a) A working spec exists at .adlc/specs/48-tutorial-v3.md, opening with user stories (actor,
    action, observable result) covering: stepping a lesson, reverting to a prior state, taking
    and skipping a quiz, resuming after closing the tab. Verify: `adlc spec-lint --prompt-only`
    passes with every criterion naming its verification.
(b) The spec's criteria name the story rails (CDP-driven browser passes) that will pin each
    lesson end to end. Verify: spec-lint + review.
(c) The open design questions each carry a reasoned recommendation, not a bare question.
    Verify: review — the PR is Myk's decision surface.

Merge tier: DESIGN-STAGE — Myk's merge, always. Implementation follows only after his word, as
its own build tickets.
title: Tutorial v3 — lessons in steps, steps with revert, understanding checked (DESIGN-STAGE)
